records.name: Gabe Longview
records.biography_en: Gabe Longview serves with Recon Detail, a special forces detail assigned to HyperNorm disturbances. The sage boonie and tiny binoculars held at chest is familiar enough to hold onto when a routine encounter becomes a surprise.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Gabe Longview looks concentrated and calm even when the briefing has run out of useful instructions.
